name: killx-macos-app
description: Build, install, and launch the native KillX macOS app.

scripts.test: set -o pipefail && swift test --build-system native -Xswiftc -F -Xswiftc /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/Library/Developer/Frameworks 2>&1 | LC_ALL=C sed -E '/warning:.*build-system native.*deprecated/d'
scripts.fresh-install: (defaults delete io.coreify.killx killx_first_launch_seen_v1 2>/dev/null || true) && npm run ship
